sentences.span: The 10-year yield broke 4.40% on Friday for the first time since May.
sentences.why: Exact match on level, day, and recency claim.

sentences.span: We think the move is a bear-steepener: the front end is anchored by a Fed on hold
sentences.why: JPMorgan document's own 'we' view; attribution and mechanism match.

sentences.span: We recommend paying 5s30s at 62bp with a stop at 48bp.
sentences.why: Exact trade, levels, and stop match; correctly attributed to JPMorgan.

sentences.span: Citi's rates desk, by contrast, sees the break as a positioning flush and expects 4.40% to hold on a closing basis.
sentences.why: Exact match on attribution and view.

sentences.span: A hot core PCE print on Thursday (consensus 0.3% m/m) would validate our steepener; a soft print would not by itself reverse it while the Fed stays on hold.
sentences.why: Source states an asymmetric conditional: only a hot print validates the steepener, and a soft print explicitly does NOT reverse it. The sentence flattens this into a symmetric 'test,' implying the print could equally confirm or invalidate the view, which changes a conditional presented as asserted.
